title: odontites glutinosus f. pilatianus
intro: Odontites glutinosus f. pilatianus, commonly known as the alpine toothwort, is a type of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestive health and providing relief from various gastrointestinal issues due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties, which help to soothe digestive discomfort and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Odontites glutinosus f. pilatianus include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
